key_points: AMD acquires World Labs for $8.2B all-stock, bringing AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li and 'physical AI' expertise
Multiple analysts (Rosenblatt, Stifel) reiterate buy ratings citing strategic fit for AI software/robotics
Deal represents ~0.8% of market cap; modest dilution but strengthens full-stack AI positioning
Senior exec clarifies no intent to compete with AI customers, easing channel concerns
Stock briefly touches $1T market cap; Bank of America resets price target post-deal
